title: The column space is the line y = 2x
caption: Both columns of [[1, 2], [2, 4]] lie along (1, 2), so col(A) is a line. (3, 6) = 3(1, 2) is on it, so Ax = (3, 6) is solvable; (1, 0) is off it, so Ax = (1, 0) has no solution.
alt: A line through the origin with direction (1, 2). Vectors (1, 2), (2, 4) and (3, 6) lie along it; the vector (1, 0) does not.
description: The columns (1, 2) and (2, 4) point the same way, so they span only a line.
b = (1, 0) is not a multiple of (1, 2): it is off the line, so no x solves Ax = b.

checks.name: the line through (1, 2) is the column space
